Find the area of a square that can be inscribed in a circle of radius 8 cm.
solutionSteps: Diameter of circle = 16 cm = Diagonal of square.

questions.question: A horse is tied to a peg at one corner of a square grass field of side 15m by means of a 5m long rope. Find the area of that part of the field in which the horse can graze.
solutionSteps: Horse grazes in a quadrant of a circle with r = 5m and \theta = 90^{\circ}.
